courses.title: Playwright: Design Patterns
courses.why: Page Object Model, fixtures and data-driven testing in Playwright: how to keep an end-to-end suite maintainable, the exact topic of senior testing questions.

courses.title: Unit Testing in Python
courses.why: Older (2020), but still the clearest short course on test-driven development with pytest; LinkedIn Learning has no newer pytest-focused course.

courses.title: Playwright Essential Training: Abstractions, Fixtures, and Complex Scenarios
courses.why: Longer than 3 hours, but the most complete current Playwright course: abstractions, fixtures and complex scenarios as a suite grows. Take it if you want depth after Design Patterns.

portals.name: Playwright docs: Getting started (official)
portals.what: Install, project structure, running tests, the HTML report and UI Mode; the reference for every Playwright API.

portals.name: Microsoft Learn: Build your first end-to-end test with Playwright
portals.what: A free 8-unit module with exercises and a module assessment that records a pass on your Microsoft Learn profile.

portals.name: pytest: Get started (official)
portals.what: Install and first tests, then fixtures, parametrisation and plugins in the rest of the docs.

portals.name: React Testing Library: Introduction (official)
portals.what: The guiding principles and queries behind testing components the way users use them.

assessments.name: PCET – Certified Entry-Level Tester with Python (PCET-30-01)
assessments.format: 35 questions in 45 minutes, 75% to pass; online through OpenEDG TestNow
assessments.credential: Digital certificate with verification code and a Credly badge, valid for 7 years
assessments.why: A quick, inexpensive testing credential: testing principles and techniques, debugging, and Python testing tools.

assessments.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL)
assessments.provider: ISTQB, delivered in the US by ASTQB / AT*SQA
assessments.format: Multiple-choice exam; at home online, at a public centre or onsite
assessments.why: The most widely recognised software-testing certification. It is QA-flavoured rather than developer-flavoured, so pair it with the Playwright project to show you can also automate.
